answer: Reward tracks novelty, not submissions. Each answer is embedded against all earlier ones; payout decays with distance to the nearest neighbour, so a paraphrase earns nothing. Seed words, here opal, delta and beacon, fix the subject but not the argument, so one topic admits many distinct contributions. Near-duplicates are zeroed as a cluster, not one by one: fifty keys off one draft are slashed together. A sybil must produce distance, which cannot be copied; each account needs its own reasoning and wording. The fiftieth identity costs what the first did, so farming never undercuts honest work.
